introduction.stringValue: Join Bayani for a new investigation. Explore the clues, explain your choices and learn how regional diversity and cultural traditions connects with Philippine history. The situations in this lesson are fictional teaching examples, not accounts of named historical events.

learningObjective.stringValue: Use evidence to explain regional diversity and cultural traditions.

lessonRecap.stringValue: Philippine communities have different languages, knowledge and practices. Region is one clue, not a complete description of every person. Surroundings can influence available materials and activities. People also make choices and learn from others. Stories, songs and spoken accounts can carry knowledge and memories. Communities may have rules about who can share some material. Traditions can keep important features while changing in some ways. New tools or settings do not automatically end a tradition. A stereotype treats a group as if every member is the same. It can hide real differences and cause harm.
